title: skilldrop packs.json
$comment: RFC-0001 / RFC-0026 / RFC-0029. Packs and outcomes are METADATA ONLY — skills never move out of flat skills/<name> folders. Packs answer WHO needs a skill; outcomes answer WHY someone opened the catalogue. Both get the same two-way membership check in validate.py.

packs.description: Role-based bundles. Keys are pack names.

description.description: One line — who this pack is for.

skills.description: Real skill folders. Every skill must appear in at least one pack.

loops.description: RFC-0028. Real loops/ folders. Every loop must appear in at least one pack.

outcomes.description: The catalogue's second browse axis. A browse aid only — never an install unit; the CLI takes no --outcome.

description.description: The chip's tooltip on the catalogue site.
